title: Raydium crypto flips $1 – Can $190M in buybacks sustain RAY’s rally?
summary: Raydium rose 33% to an 8-month high of $1.19, aided by tight supply.
content: Raydium recently surged 33 percent to reach an eight-month high of $1.19, successfully crossing the one dollar mark. The notable rally was significantly aided by tight supply dynamics in the market. Observers are now evaluating whether ongoing buybacks totaling $190 million will be sufficient to sustain the upward momentum for RAY moving forward.

title: TD Bank COO leaves after less than a year in the job
summary: TD Bank's COO Taylan Turan is leaving the Canadian lender after less than a year in the job as part of a wider shakeup that also sees Vlad Shpilsky appointed group head, global technology and solutions.
content: TD Bank's Chief Operating Officer Taylan Turan is departing from the Canadian lender following a tenure of less than a year. The departure is part of a broader leadership shakeup within the organization. As part of these changes, Vlad Shpilsky has been appointed to the role of group head of global technology and solutions.
